comments.body:
Hi Camillo,

You may find some information in this [issue](https://github.com/assembly-101/assembly101-action-recognition/issues/1).
We modify the [RU-LSTM](https://github.com/fpv-iplab/rulstm/blob/master/FEATEXT/extract_example_rgb.py) code for feature extraction by replacing the TSN with a TSM.

Please let us know if you face any issues.

comments.author: dibschat
comments.body:
Hi Camillo,

If I understood correctly, are you using your custom per-frame feature extraction code using our pretrained (on all 12 views) TSM and then comparing with the per-frame features provided by us in the drive?

What metric are you using to calculate the feature similarity? (e.g. L2, L1?) Note that the features might will not be exact and will depend on the input transform you are using and the best way to check is to run any [segmentation baselines](https://github.com/assembly-101/assembly101-temporal-action-segmentation) with your features and see if you can reproduce the results.

Instead of using the [RU-LSTM](https://github.com/fpv-iplab/rulstm/blob/master/FEATEXT/extract_example_rgb.py#L27) transforms, please use the image transforms provided in [test_models.py](https://github.com/assembly-101/assembly101-action-recognition/blob/main/TSM-action-recognition/test_models.py#L155) as follows:
```python
transform = torchvision.transforms.Compose([
            GroupScale(net.scale_size),
            GroupCenterCrop(input_size),
            Stack(roll=(this_arch in ['BNInception', 'InceptionV3'])),
            ToTorchFormatTensor(div=(this_arch not in ['BNInception', 'InceptionV3'])),
            GroupNormalize(net.input_mean, net.input_std),
        ])
```

Let me know if this works !
